content.comment_body: When installing [product_name], the folder for the application.ini is located at c:\documents and settings\%username%\.[product_name][version_no]. This folder is protected on our computers, so I'd like to change where the ini files are saved. How can I do this? Thank you in advance

Hello, I believe [product_name] requires the configuration file to be in its default folder, and this location cannot be changed. Alternatively, you can run [product_name] directly from the CD if your administrator cannot install it on your PC. While this is slower, it will still work.

Hello, Even when running [product_name] from the CD, I encounter the same issue. [product_name] still tries to save ini files to c:\documents and settings\%username%\[product_name][version_no], which is protected by a program called skanix Illusion. When a new user logs in, a 'virtual' profile is created in this folder, but [product_name] does not recognize it. My only solution is to store the ini files in an unprotected folder, which is why I want the option to change settings in [product_name]. Thank you in advance

analysis.insight_summary: The user is experiencing a limitation with [product_name], as its settings files are saved by default to a protected system directory, which they cannot access or modify. Running the software from a CD does not solve this, as it still attempts to write to the restricted folder. Security applications that virtualize or redirect user profiles further complicate access, preventing [product_name] from operating correctly in such environments.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wants the ability to select a different location for [product_name] ini files so that they can use the software in environments where certain folders are protected or restricted.
